title: Missing explanation of unusual words (AAA)
user_impact: Users with cognitive impairments or non-native speakers do not understand the text.
technical_impact: Missing glossary linkage or in-text explanation.

checks.applicability: Pages with any visible text (text outside title, script, style, noscript).
checks.expectation:
One needs_review (UNTESTED) note per page, at the root, on every page with
text; never pass or violation. A page without any text (an image with alt
only) gets no note.
checks.manual_reason: Whether a word is jargon or an idiom, and whether it is explained, is a judgement about language no detector makes.
